coverage_limit: Selected files/queries only. Reference and index records are not experimental training observations; T-psi-C includes independently audited linked studies.

resources.name: circAtlas v3
resources.integration_role: Reference coordinates and identifier reconciliation, not measured expression or translation labels
limitations: Full human coordinate file was inspected, not the entire database
Coordinate download contains no tissue/cell expression or protein-output columns
Do not infer full-length isoform identity from a BSJ coordinate alone
Genome assembly and coordinate conventions must be independently preserved

resources.name: CircTarget
resources.integration_role: Read-supported RNA-RNA interaction evidence with computed significance
limitations: Only the A549 archive was inspected
BSJ supported and nonBSJ supported interactions must remain distinct
Chimeric read counts and P-values are not activation, leakage or protein-output labels
No causal effect on translation established by an interaction

resources.name: RiboSeq.Org portal family
resources.integration_role: Endogenous footprint signal and study/sample discovery; possible mRNA TE after matched RNA-seq processing
limitations: One cell-filtered metadata export and one 1-MiB BigWig prefix were inspected, not all studies
227 Ribo-Seq, 5 RNA-Seq, 1 tRNA-Seq, 1 SSU entries are not 234 independent comparable TE measurements
Same cell name includes normal, drug, infection and genetic perturbation contexts
Footprint occupancy can reflect elongation or stalling and is not direct protein synthesis rate
Do not pool with reporter luminescence or polysome-loading labels
Deduplicate upstream accessions against RPFdb and model training atlases

resources.name: riboCIRC v2
resources.integration_role: Context-specific inferred endogenous translation evidence and literature-curated evidence; not a quantitative synthetic circRNA-by-cell output matrix
limitations: Two complete downloadable archives inspected, not all riboCIRC datasets
Context-specific means source-context evidence, not a calibrated cell-selectivity score
Source_ is heterogeneous text and often only an SRX identifier; explicit cell mapping still needed
Footprints and unique footprints are counts of supporting evidence, not RNA-normalized protein output
Predicted ORFs, m6A/IRES/RBP annotations and literature evidence must retain their evidence types
HTTP official site works; HTTPS timed out; legacy sysbio human ZIP links return404 through web tool

resources.name: RPFdb v3
resources.integration_role: Potential endogenous translation-efficiency source; current file contents not verified
limitations: Download documentation is not data-file verification
Keep prior metadata evidence level; do not label training-ready
Official page describes unmatched samples and missing TE values; matched RNA-seq must be checked

resources.name: TransCirc
resources.integration_role: Potential circRNA translation-evidence aggregate; actual payload unverified
limitations: v1 download documentation is not proof of a current v2 payload
No bulk or representative data rows inspected
Computed translation potential is not experimentally measured protein output

resources.name: Sci-ModoM
resources.integration_role: Can annotate endogenous sequence/site context or support modification-assay analyses. Not a direct label or measured modification state for delivered synthetic RNA.
limitations: One HEK293T BID-seq pseudouridine dataset audited; no database-wide numerical validation
Dataset title says three replicates, but exported file has one record per site without replicate columns
Current docs describe newer /datasets routes that return404 on this deployed site; legacy routes discovered from its own public application work
Cross-study cell identity does not establish matching culture, dose, time or intracellular RNA modification state

resources.name: m6A-Atlas v2.0
resources.integration_role: Useful endogenous annotation and exploratory context evidence after genome/condition reconciliation; cannot mark the corresponding position as modified in an engineered reporter.
limitations: 843678 support rows refer to427760 unique sites; do not treat support rows as independent modified positions
High-resolution support and bulk quantification have different assay interpretations
Quantification file read as bounded compressed prefix only; no full-file count or checksum claimed
No full measured synthetic-RNA modification-to-protein output matrix
Reported logFC values must not be interpreted as calibrated occupancy fractions

resources.name: tModBase v2.0
resources.integration_role: Exploratory functional tRNA context only after selecting comparable assays and treatments. Inspected numerical condition is perturbed and cannot be assigned to untreated HepG2 reporter output.
limitations: 650 tRNA entities but only81 with nonzero counts/coverage in inspected response
total field is zero in every inspected entity despite positive counts in81; interpretation remains unresolved
No per-replicate entity dimension; metadata can aggregate multiple GSMs
Cell labels alone do not establish preparation or biological-condition equivalence
One numerical condition verified, not all528 datasets

resources.name: T-psi-C tRNA sequencing study index
resources.integration_role: Useful study discovery. Downloaded charging studies support their own stress/cell-state analyses; neither is a matched cell-context covariate matrix for the circRNA reporter panels.
limitations: GSE239867 covers mouse MEFs and human NTERT keratinocytes under stress; unlabeled colon-separated count columns require mapping before calculation
GSE188855 has12 samples and67 tRNA IDs per file, with Ratio equal to100*CCA/(CCA+CC) within rounding
GSE188855 sample GSM5691036 title is Lung_starvation_rep1 but treatment metadata says untreated; preserve the conflict and resolve against study design before assigning labels
The GSE188855 study is a separately investigated charging experiment; current T-psi-C index explicitly links GSE239867
No circRNA/mRNA protein-output labels in these tRNA processed files

resources.name: MODOMICS (2025 update)
resources.integration_role: Use as chemical/reference vocabulary and site annotation only; cannot join by cell to predict output.
limitations: Audited three legacy .mods files within one download archive, not every current MODOMICS endpoint
No cell-line or protein-output fields in inspected tables
Reference positions do not imply modification stoichiometry or actual presence in a new synthetic RNA

resources.name: Human Protein Atlas RNA expression downloads

limitations: No replicate column or matched reporter condition; RNA expression does not establish protein activity.

resources.integration_role: External expression features:1673 models by19193 genes; inspect24Q4 rather than assume latest.

HEK293T absent among exact requested RRID candidates in this Model.csv.

HCT-8 ACH-001084 exists in Model.csv but has no row in this selected expression matrix; metadata availability is not numeric expression coverage.

resources.name: ENCODE RNA experiments
resources.integration_role: RBP-binding and cell-free motif evidence; selected knockdown RNA quantifications are not matched translation labels.

Knockdown quantification without matched controls is not an effect estimate.

22 columns observed but exact definitions of extra scores and assembly unresolved.
